name: figma-translator

scripts.copy-files: cp manifest.json dist/ && cp ui.html dist/ && npm run fix-manifest
scripts.fix-manifest: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('dist/manifest.json')); manifest.main='code.js'; fs.writeFileSync('dist/manifest.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2));"
scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run watch

description: Plugin do Figma para traduzir textos usando ChatGPT
